name: Icon captions
description: Captions with pictures: when a word that has an icon is said, the icon pops up above it on an accent badge — from a built-in list (time, video, money, idea, launch…) and your own `word:icon` pairs. Give a transcript with --words.

text.label: Text
text.description: what is said; leave empty to caption the transcript as it is. Wrap a word in *stars* for the accent
text.default: Your *videos* keep people watching, right on time.

accents.label: Accent words
accents.description: words to put in the accent wherever they are said, comma separated

icons.label: Icons
icons.description: your own word:icon pairs, comma separated, e.g. launch:rocket, price:dollar (motion_api lists the icon names)

auto.label: Built-in icons
auto.description: pick icons for common words (time, video, money, idea, launch…)

parts.words: the caption words and everything drawn with them
